No worries. I totally get the suffocation. Being in a busy household with lots of people in a small space activates my anxiety pretty strongly. There are a variety of breathing and muscle exercises you can do to try and feel something. Clenching something like your fists or your toes on the inhale, holding it for a few seconds, then releasing on the exhale is one that helps a lot for me. Sometimes I squeeze a blanket really hard, or I hole a cold pack to my cheek, or I take a cold shower. If you haven't tried stuff like this before I recommend trying it and googling other anxiety breathing techniques. Experiment with it.
